name: rocket_launcher
notes: A straight tube: the rocket flies level and bursts on whatever it meets. It takes a third of its own blast, which is enough to rocket-jump onto the catwalk and not quite enough to kill you doing it. One in the tube and a second to reload, so a rocket already away is no reason to wait -- three of them can be in the air at once. The right button fires a guided rocket, a little slower and a fifth weaker, that turns after wherever you are pointing -- not at once, it swings round behind your aim -- so you can fly it round a corner or walk it onto a man who dodged.
